description: In combination with `esm-scen7-h-SST`, quantifies the effective radiative forcing (ERF) of future changes in anthropogenic aerosols. Same as `esm-scen7-h-SST`, except anthropogenic aerosol and aerosol precursor (BC, OC, NH3, SO2) emissions are held at present-day (2021) values. Atmosphere-only counterpart of `esm-scen7-h-Aer`.
